chunk_findings.detail: The accepted route is a T2 `lane.approve` under the approvals group: chat goes through `approvals ask`/`attest` and the agent carries `--approval ID` with a proxy stamp, and a terminal person must pass a `--digest` read receipt, for both `lane-template:<name>` and `lane-plugin:<harness>`, staying out of RULES/RETRY_VERBS and out of `surfaces/declared/lanes.py`. This instead adds `lanes approve <name>` and calls `T.approve(log, t, requested_agent=agent)` on whatever `templates.get(name)` is now, with no digest argument. Given template `foo` at digest AAA, a person who read AAA, then an edit that changes the file to BBB before they run `ddflow lanes approve foo`, the command grants BBB (`digest=t.digest()` of the reloaded record) with no read receipt, so the approval is not bound to the digest they saw. An empty `agent` (the default) is not treated as an agent here, so the refusal the docstring claims does not happen on that input. Plugin targets and the ask/attest/`--approval` path are not implemented.
